name: Harbor Docs
functionality: form login at /login and JSON login at /api/login (cookie session harbor_session)
dashboard with the caller's projects and recently viewed documents
project list, project page with documents (state, author) and current members
document page and version history (pages fetch /api/documents/{id} and /versions)

approval requests for documents in review; approve/reject (approver permission)
team activity feed (HTML page renders the JSON feed filtered to the viewer's projects)
profile with current and historical project memberships
ownership transfer of a document (author or project lead)

workflows.name: document approval
rules: a draft is visible only to its author (other project members see its title and state in the project list, never its content)
in_review documents are visible to project members and to team approvers
only approvers may decide an approval request (approve -> approved, reject -> draft)
only the author or the project lead may transfer ownership, to a current project member

workflows.name: project membership
rules: access to a private project's metadata and documents requires CURRENT membership (removed_at null)
removed members keep a membership record with removed_at for history; it grants nothing
team approvers may read non-draft documents of any team project

invariants: a user who is not a current member of a project cannot read its documents or metadata through any interface
a draft's content is readable only by its author, through every interface (document, versions, shares)
the team activity feed only reveals events of projects the caller can open
removing a member revokes access immediately on every interface
state-changing actions require the right role and a CSRF token

seeded.title: Team activity feed discloses private-project metadata to non-members
seeded.evidence: As dave, GET /api/projects/cobalt returns 403 and cobalt is absent from GET /api/projects, yet GET /api/teams/meridian/activity returns events with project 'cobalt', document titles such as 'Cobalt — layoffs scenario Q3' and 'Cobalt — restructuring cost model', document ids and the acting user (finn, erin). The HTML /activity page filters these out client-side.
seeded.discovery: Open the Activity page and observe the JSON it fetches (or GET the API directly); compare the projects in the feed with /api/projects and the access decision of /api/projects/cobalt.
seeded.verification: Identity dave (never a cobalt member); resource cobalt events in /api/teams/meridian/activity; expected boundary: feed limited to projects dave can open; observed: cobalt project name, titles and actors returned (200); control interface: /api/projects/cobalt -> 403 and /api/documents/d-c3f812 -> 403 for dave.
requires: cross-resource correlation (feed vs project access decision)

seeded.title: Draft content readable by project members through the versions interface
seeded.evidence: As dave (or finn), GET /api/documents/d-b25d07 (erin's draft in beacon) returns 404, but GET /api/documents/d-b25d07/versions lists 2 versions with excerpts and GET /api/documents/d-b25d07/versions/2 returns the full draft content ('Sunset the Harbor Classic tier in Q2 2027; ...').
seeded.discovery: Beacon project page / GET /api/projects/beacon/documents lists d-b25d07 with state 'draft' (title only); the activity feed also references it. The document API's links and the Version history page expose the versions interface.
seeded.verification: Identity dave (current beacon member, not the author); resource d-b25d07 in state draft; expected boundary: draft content only for the author; observed: versions/2 returns 200 with content; control interface: /api/documents/d-b25d07 -> 404 for dave and 200 for erin.
requires: two identities (author and member) or the workflow-state rule
testing a related interface of the same object
seeded.match_note: Scored by the vulnerable object: any non-rejected finding on the draft's versions interface (d-b25d07 is the only draft readable by other members). Wording-based rules both over- and under-credited (corrected 2026-11-23, applied to all runs).

seeded.title: Removed project member keeps read access to the project's documents
seeded.expected: Confirmed vulnerability (broken access control after membership change, CWE-284/CWE-613)
seeded.evidence: As dave, /api/me lists atlas with removed_at 2026-11-16T15:42:00Z; GET /api/projects/atlas and /api/projects/atlas/documents return 403; GET /api/documents/d-a71f30 (in dave's /api/me/recent from 2026-11-13) still returns 200 with the full contract terms, as does d-a79e15 (created after his removal, id in the activity feed). finn, never an atlas member, gets 403 on the same ids.
seeded.discovery: /api/me (membership history with removed_at), /api/me/recent and the dashboard's 'Recently viewed' list (atlas entries from before the removal); the activity feed also references atlas documents.
seeded.verification: Identity dave (former atlas member, removed_at set); resource d-a71f30; expected boundary: current membership required; observed: 200 with content; control interfaces: /api/projects/atlas -> 403 for dave, /api/documents/d-a71f30 -> 403 for finn, /api/documents/d-a71f30/versions -> 403 for dave.
requires: a second identity or interface as control
seeded.match_note: Scored by the vulnerable object (atlas documents) and the affected identity (the removed member, dave) or removal wording (corrected 2026-11-23, applied to all runs).
